title: Regulatory flexibility for effectively competitive services.
bodyText: The commission may allow telecommunications carriers to have pricing flexibility for services that the commission finds are effectively competitive; provided that universal service is preserved and advanced.
bodyHtml: §269-38  Regulatory flexibility for effectively competitive services.  The commission may allow telecommunications carriers to have pricing flexibility for services that the commission finds are effectively competitive; provided that universal service is preserved and advanced. [L 1995, c 225, pt of §2; am L 2019, c 229, §4]
